## Description
&#10;&#9;&#9;Sulfuric acid (also spelled sulphuric acid), with the chemical formula H₂SO₄, &#10;&#9;&#9;is the most produced industrial chemical globally, primarily used in &#10;&#9;&#9;fertilizer manufacturing, petroleum refining, and lead-acid batteries. &#10;&#9;&#9; It is a colorless, odorless, viscous, and highly corrosive mineral &#10;&#9;&#9; acid that acts as a strong dehydrating and oxidizing agent.
